1 · Intro

When to use it.

Student workers are students paid for work they perform. They need an I-9 but no background check.

Under federal wage law, most students working for a college are non-exempt and covered by minimum wage and overtime rules, so their pay runs from approved UKG time cards.

Use this whenA department wants to pay an enrolled student for work and you need to set up or extend the record.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • An end date that does not match the work period keeps a student active and payable after they stop working. Review end dates at every term change.
  • Graduate teaching and research assistants may be treated differently under the FLSA (DOL Fact Sheet #17S). Do not decide exemption yourself; ask Compensation.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt rules on student hour limits, eligibility checks, and who confirms enrollment are not yet documented.

HCM Academy job aid · Students

Student Workers

Use when: A department wants to pay an enrolled student for work and you need to set up or extend the record. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Search the student in Our Workforce > Employment Info.
  2. N record only: add the employment Work Relationship. Existing E assignment: add an assignment.
    • N only: add Work Relationship
    • Has E: Add Assignment
  3. Enter the position and assignment details, including the end date.
  4. Set hire reason Hire employment and status Active payroll eligible.
  5. Complete the I-9 within three business days of the first paid day. No background check.
    • Original documents, examined in person
  6. Submit, track approval with the notifications bell, then confirm costing and UKG.

Watch-outs

  • An end date that does not match the work period keeps a student active and payable after they stop working. Review end dates at every term change.
  • Graduate teaching and research assistants may be treated differently under the FLSA (DOL Fact Sheet #17S). Do not decide exemption yourself; ask Compensation.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt rules on student hour limits, eligibility checks, and who confirms enrollment are not yet documented.
